title: OpenMLS: extend targeted KAT generator (suites 1-3, sizes, rejects)
description: On a new branch of ~/GIT/openmls off mimid-0.9.2, extend openmls/src/targeted_messages/kat.rs to emit positive vectors for suites 1,2,3 (sizes: min 17B, ciphertext Nh-1/Nh/Nh+1, typical, ~4KiB, big padding; empty and non-empty AAD) and negative vectors for each Recipient Validation step, with valid flag and expected failure step. Nonzero padding via a test-only sender hook. OpenMLS must also verify Python-generated vectors.
notes: Result 2026-11-02: worktree ~/GIT/openmls-tm, branch targeted-kat-vectors-02 based on upstream b68a50a36 (openmls #2173, draft -02), uncommitted; changed openmls/src/targeted_messages/{kat.rs,mod.rs}. Wrote ~/PROJECT/targeted-vectors/openmls-vectors.json: 60 vectors, 20 per suite 1/2/3 (7 valid + 13 invalid each). Verifier (kat::tests::verify_vector_file, TM_VECTORS=<path>) passes 60/60 on them and 3/3 on b68a50a36 checked-in vectors (regression). OpenMLS rejection order matches draft step order for every failure value. Caveats: MalformedContent conflates non-zero padding and bad application_data varint (both reported as padding); ciphertext byte flip inside first KDF.Nh bytes fails at sender_data not signature. NOTE: mimid-0.9.2 implements draft -01 (empty HPKE context, TargetedMessageTBM as HPKE aad); draft -02 vectors fail at ciphertext there. Tracked as mimid-f0ox.
close_reason: Cross-validated 2026-11-02: Python verifies 60/60 OpenMLS (-02, base b68a50a36) vectors; OpenMLS verifies 54/54 Python vectors; both compare failure step. Outputs in ~/PROJECT/targeted-vectors/.
